scientific_integrity: Every claim pertains to the 2-independence complex of the stated graph and its vertex deletions/links. Exact integral unit pivots and independently computed mod-two homology have been checked.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete classification of the labeled Frucht graph, not a cubic-graph family theorem; originality subject to unindexed literature risk. All Morse computations and certificates reproducible; independent audit not performed.
title: Complete deletion–link homotopy profiles of the Frucht two-independence complex
